description: Checks one IPv4 address against nine public DNS blocklists at once — SpamCop, UCEPROTECT, PSBL, Barracuda, DroneBL and four more — and returns each list's raw return code plus the reason text the list itself publishes, not a score. Every list is re-checked on each call with its RFC 5782 test entry, so a dead list or one that refuses queries comes back as unavailable instead of reading as clean. Includes the delisting URL for each hit. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

ip.description: The IPv4 address to check. IPv6 is not accepted: these nine lists are IPv4 zones.

name: red_dnsbl
title: IP blocklist check
